//: Scope only (openspec: ci-security-gates, design D3). Accepted findings go in security/accepted-findings.json, never here.

filter_paths drops a finding when any of its code is in: lib/ and node_modules/ (dependencies), vendor/ (pinned upstream EntryPoint and CreateX), test/ and script/ (never deployed), src/testing/ (test-only contracts production never deploys).
Slither splits filter_paths on commas and strips a trailing slash, so each pattern is anchored at packages/contracts/.
Informational and optimization detectors are off; they are severity filters, not suppressions. Low and Medium stay on and appear in the uploaded report.
